viator_experiences.title: Walking and Drinking Evening Tour in Liverpool
viator_experiences.summary: This evening walking tour pairs sightseeing of Liverpool's highlights with three pub stops to sample drinks along the way. Led by an English-speaking…
viator_experiences.description_md: This evening walking tour pairs sightseeing of Liverpool's highlights with three pub stops to sample drinks along the way. Led by an English-speaking guide in a small group, the route takes in landmarks including the city's two cathedrals, Chinatown and the famous Cavern Club. Between the sights you pause for a drink while your guide shares the history behind the city and its Beatles connections. The relaxed, personalised format blends local culture and traditional pubs over roughly two and a quarter hours.
